about: Bore hone, self-made in Blender (sources/hone/build_hone.py) from photos of Sunnen's ML-5000 power-stroked horizontal hone (Liberty Machinery, The Equipment Hub, Exapro listings) and the record: the off-white base cabinet with the SUNNEN logotype and sunburst on castors with its foot pedal; the dark grey work tray with its corner hooks; the head with its blue control face (load dial, knobs, pilot lamps, lit size readout) and the horizontal spindle carrying the mandrel with its stones and a part in the stroking fixture on its rail; the coolant unit to the right with its tray top and access panel; the raised blue control panel (readout, knobs, buttons, e-stop) on its conduit. The spindle points -X at the placeholder's mandrel height (planner.placeholders.honing_machine).
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against ML-5000 listing photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked
